heading.title: Parties to Notes, Bills and Cheques.

article.title: Liability of drawer.
article.content: The drawer of a bill of exchange or cheque is bound, in case of dishonour by the drawee or acceptor thereof, to compensate the holder, provided due notice of dishonour has been given to, or received by, the drawer as hereinafter provided.
article.html:
30Liability of drawer.

Section 30 · Chapter III · page 12 of the Act

The drawer of a bill of exchange or cheque is bound, in case of dishonour by the drawee or acceptor thereof, to compensate the holder, provided due notice of dishonour has been given to, or received by, the drawer as hereinafter provided.
